list.item: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome, post-infectious, moderate severity, with orthostatic intolerance; synthetic modern diagnosis by NICE and IOM criteria, linked to her documented Crimean fever and decades of illness, which are only retrospectively and disputedly read as ME/CFS: active, confirmed [S]

Personal history of brucellosis diagnosed by serology during an overseas field-hospital deployment and treated with six weeks of doxycycline and rifampin; no evidence of relapse: active, confirmed [S]

Diagnose ME/CFS by clinical criteria after exclusion tests, explain that it is a real illness with no diagnostic test, and give her a written care and support plan, including a flare plan. Guideline: Myalgic encephalomyelitis (or encephalopathy)/chronic fatigue syndrome: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG206) (2021); Diagnosing ME/CFS (2024) [S]

Energy management led by the patient: an activity and symptom diary, planned rest before and between tasks, work broken into short blocks, and heart-rate awareness; no graded exercise therapy or fixed increases in activity. Guideline: Myalgic encephalomyelitis (or encephalopathy)/chronic fatigue syndrome: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG206) (2021); Diagnosing ME/CFS (2024); Grach SL, et al. Diagnosis and Management of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome. Mayo Clin Proc 2023;98(10):1544-1551 (2023) [S]

Infectious diseases consultation to look for relapsed or focal brucellosis or another persisting infection before attributing her symptoms to ME/CFS. Guideline: Myalgic encephalomyelitis (or encephalopathy)/chronic fatigue syndrome: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG206) (2021); Clinical Overview of Brucellosis (2024); Pappas G, Akritidis N, Bosilkovski M, Tsianos E. Brucellosis. N Engl J Med 2005;352(22):2325-2336 (2005) [S]

Orthostatic intolerance measures: 2 to 2.5 L of fluid a day, more salt with meals, waist-high compression garments, and tasks done seated or reclined; repeat the standing test at six months. Guideline: Myalgic encephalomyelitis (or encephalopathy)/chronic fatigue syndrome: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG206) (2021); Grach SL, et al. Diagnosis and Management of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome. Mayo Clin Proc 2023;98(10):1544-1551 (2023) [S]

Sleep, pain, and cognitive symptom care: a regular sleep window with rest periods kept short, acetaminophen as needed, no sedatives or opioids, and memory aids for work. Guideline: Myalgic encephalomyelitis (or encephalopathy)/chronic fatigue syndrome: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG206) (2021); Diagnosing ME/CFS (2024) [S]

Vitamin D repletion with cholecalciferol 2,000 units daily, rechecked after about three months. Guideline: Myalgic encephalomyelitis (or encephalopathy)/chronic fatigue syndrome: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG206) (2021) [S]

Review the care plan at every visit, with PHQ-9, PROMIS fatigue and physical function scores, and a pain score; primary care review at least yearly and more often while the plan is new. Guideline: Myalgic encephalomyelitis (or encephalopathy)/chronic fatigue syndrome: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG206) (2021) [S]

Workplace adjustments: home working, a reclined workstation, flexible hours, and meetings by video or at her home. Guideline: Myalgic encephalomyelitis (or encephalopathy)/chronic fatigue syndrome: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG206) (2021); Diagnosing ME/CFS (2024) [S]
